xh01-01.en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.
xh01-01.draft: Umoya omncinci wokuqala wosuku usandul' ukufika. Wuqhwabele izandla.

xh01-02.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.

xh01-03.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.

xh01-04.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
xh01-04.draft: Intaba izigqume intloko ngengubo. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.

xh01-05.en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
xh01-05.draft: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nesibhakabhaka.

xh01-06.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
xh01-06.draft: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali.
xh01-06.held: held after Maat fix: held: checker triage-high

xh01-07.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
xh01-07.draft: Inyanga ityelela phakathi kwamafu. Iyayiva ivumba lenyama ukusuka phaya phezulu.

xh01-08.en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
xh01-08.draft: Isiqwengana sokugqibela seenkuni sisigqibo, asiyonto nje ekhoyo.

xh01-09.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
xh01-09.draft: Inyanga ingemva kwelifu, inja isestoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.

xh01-10.en: Bring your own ice. The friendship doesn't cover ice.
xh01-10.draft: Yiza nomkhenkce wakho. Ubuhlobo abubandakanyi umkhenkce.

xh01-11.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
xh01-11.draft: Loo mafu adlula nje. Nditsho nombona uyazi ukuba akufuneki uvuye.

xh01-12.en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
xh01-12.draft: Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku yenza zonke izitrato zibe ziindawo zokwenza ifilimu.

xh01-13.en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.
xh01-13.draft: Lelona xesha lihle losuku. Kwaye lelona lifutshane. Baleka.

xh01-14.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
xh01-14.draft: Ngu-6 ngentsasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.

xh01-15.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
xh01-15.draft: Ihlathi lithe cwaka namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.

xh01-16.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
xh01-16.draft: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle bavumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.

xh01-17.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
xh01-17.draft: Kuyabanda nyhani namhlanje. Yingqele egqobhoza iijezi ezintathu ngathi azikho.

xh01-18.en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
xh01-18.draft: Icala elinesithunzi lebala lilizwe lalo ngokwalo.

xh01-19.en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
xh01-19.draft: Isibhakabhaka saseKaroo: luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olufanayo kwiikhilomitha ezingama-400 ezizayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.
xh01-19.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank

xh01-20.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
xh01-20.draft: Isandla ekepusini, inyathelo ngenyathelo. Umoya omncinci uhamba naye.

xh01-21.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
xh01-21.draft: Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci unamacebo awo angeCawa.

xh01-22.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
xh01-22.draft: Isibhakabhaka senza umboniso. Iintlanzi, njengesiqhelo, azenzi.

xh02-01.en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.
xh02-01.draft: Ingqele yaseKapa yingqele emanzi. Ingena emathanjeni akho ize ihlale.

xh02-02.en: Rooibos in hand, blanket to the ears. Full kit.
xh02-02.draft: IRooibos esandleni, ingubo ide ifike ezindlebeni. Sizixhobile.

xh02-03.en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.

xh02-04.en: The whole town just switched itself to whisper volume.

xh02-05.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
xh02-05.draft: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zizithathela indawo.

xh02-06.en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
xh02-06.draft: Isiselo sokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba sihlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.
xh02-06.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank

xh02-07.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
xh02-07.draft: Ndilibale ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ngobusuku. Bonke.

xh02-08.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.

xh02-09.en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.
xh02-09.draft: Imozulu yenze amacebo. Thina siphendule nje sathi siyeza.

xh02-10.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
xh02-10.draft: IDolophu enoBubele ayizange icele ukuba yiDolophu enoMoya, kodwa ke.

xh02-11.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
xh02-11.draft: Nditsho neempala zimi emthunzini ziphinda zicinga ngezigqibo zazo.

xh02-12.en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.
xh02-12.draft: Umoya oshushu wasezintabeni utshintshe ebusuku. Kapa, namhlanje uphantse ube yi-Upington.

xh02-13.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
xh02-13.draft: Induli ishukuma ngathi ngamaza. Iinkomo zigqibe ekubeni zingaboni nto.

xh02-14.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
xh02-14.draft: Isibhakabhaka sithe cwaka, nomgca uthe cwaka. UMvulo akakayifumani ivolyum.

xh02-15.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
xh02-15.draft: Izihlangu kwiikona zengubo. Umoya omncinci wamkelekile, isanti ayamkelekanga.

xh02-16.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
xh02-16.draft: Ilaphu letafile li-ayiniwe kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.

xh02-17.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
xh02-17.draft: Amafu ambalwa eze kubukela. Nawo akabaleki.

xh02-18.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
xh02-18.draft: Inyanga isoloko iphuma ijonga igaraji. Akukho nto yenzekayo.

xh02-19.draft: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sayinwa ngumkhenkce.

xh02-20.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
xh02-20.draft: Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owa uvela esibhakabhakeni.

xh02-21.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
xh02-21.draft: Umpompo womoya awukholelwa kwixesha lokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa.

xh02-22.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
xh02-22.draft: Iflegi yekona ibonisa kanye apho ibhola iza kutyekela khona.

xh03-01.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
xh03-01.draft: Inkungu yaseMidlands: indlela amaphandle azifihla ngayo.

xh03-02.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
xh03-02.draft: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokudibana nomntu 'obusoloko uceba ukumtsalela umnxeba'.

xh03-03.en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
xh03-03.draft: Iintsasa zaseHighveld: kubanda kakhulu, kuhle, akukho kuxolisa.
xh03-03.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank

xh03-04.en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.
xh03-04.draft: Nditsho nenja ijonge imozulu yaza yabuyela ebhedini.

xh03-05.en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.
xh03-05.draft: Ilanga liqale umsebenzi phambi kokuba i-alamu yakho izame.

xh03-06.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
xh03-06.draft: Inyanga ikhanya kancinci ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko asinako oko.

xh03-07.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
xh03-07.draft: Umoya omncinci wenza wonke umsebenzi. Ikhayithi ifumana lonke udumo.

xh03-08.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
xh03-08.draft: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zizathu. UMvulo uphantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.

xh03-09.en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.
xh03-09.draft: Ukubona: akukho. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.

xh03-10.en: The sea has vanished but the tannies are here. Priorities.
xh03-10.draft: Ulwandle lunyamalele kodwa oomakazi bakhona. Izinto eziphambili.

xh03-11.en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.
xh03-11.draft: Umphefumlo omnye womoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke liyimbongi.

xh03-12.en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
xh03-12.draft: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona.

xh03-13.en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.
xh03-13.draft: Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Thina asinakutsho njalo.

xh03-15.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
xh03-15.draft: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Inyani, liyakufanele.

xh03-16.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
xh03-16.draft: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, amanzi okunkcenkceshela iidiliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.

xh03-17.en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
xh03-17.draft: Yithi inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise ibraai yangoMgqibelo.

xh03-18.en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
xh03-18.draft: Onke amacebo ngoku afuduselwe 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.

xh03-19.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
xh03-19.draft: Nditsho ne-hadeda ithe cwaka. Isibhakabhaka simisele umzekelo.

xh03-20.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
xh03-20.draft: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka bangwevu ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.

xh03-21.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
xh03-21.draft: Iiglasi zelanga ziyanxitywa, ziyakhululwa, ziyanxitywa. Emva kwemini ngoLwesihlanu kukuzilolonga.

xh03-22.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
xh03-22.draft: Ulwandle luziidigri ezili-12. Ngentsimbi yeshumi luza kuziva ngathi yispa.

xh04-01.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
xh04-01.draft: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akuze kubande ngoku bayavuma.

xh04-02.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
xh04-02.draft: Ilanga alizukuza kujonga ukukhazimla namhlanje. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.

xh04-03.en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
xh04-03.draft: Ungwevu wempelaveki: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto konke konke.

xh04-04.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
xh04-04.draft: Ithafa lonke ngathi umbala uthotyiwe. Iigusha zibalwa ngendlela efanayo noko.

xh04-05.en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
xh04-05.draft: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku nengqele enkulu.

xh04-06.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
xh04-06.draft: Ilaphu letafile lentaba lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.

xh04-07.en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
xh04-07.draft: Ifama isekhona. Sikholelwa nje kwilizwi lomnye nomnye.

xh04-08.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
xh04-08.draft: Mfusa emhlabeni, mhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamkelwe.

xh04-09.en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.

xh04-10.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
xh04-10.draft: Amafu abe pinki kanye ngexesha lokupakisha. Akukho mntu upakishileyo.

xh04-11.en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
xh04-11.draft: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Hayi.

xh04-12.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
xh04-12.draft: Uthuli lukhazimla ngathi yigolide ekukhanyeni kokutshona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.

xh04-13.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
xh04-13.draft: Izilwanyana zasendle azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azikhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.

xh04-14.en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
xh04-14.draft: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: ngwevu, icocekile, ayixeli nto.

xh04-15.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
xh04-15.draft: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayidingi mvume yelanga.

xh04-16.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
xh04-16.draft: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba asiyiyo imozulu. Umlilo uhlala uvutha.

xh04-17.en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.
xh04-17.draft: Ifronti ihambile. Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina.
xh04-17.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank

xh04-18.en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
xh04-18.draft: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ubusuku bufikile noko.

xh04-19.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
xh04-19.draft: Amafu emva kwemini yonke, akukho thontsi. Umbhobho wamanzi ubuyele emsebenzini.

xh04-20.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
xh04-20.draft: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kungwevu olukhanyayo saya kungwevu olumnyama. Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo.

xh04-21.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
xh04-21.draft: Umoya omncinci usashushu ngeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

xh04-22.en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.
xh04-22.draft: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini lingavalelisanga. Akukho mbeko, kodwa siyaqonda.

xh05-01.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.

xh05-02.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
xh05-02.draft: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwabadlali bamaza. Ithi: hambani.

xh05-03.en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.
xh05-03.draft: Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.

xh05-04.en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.
xh05-04.draft: Xa imozulu iziphethe kakuhle kangaka, nathi siyaziphatha. Phantse.

xh05-05.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
xh05-05.draft: Ilanga, emva koko ilifu, emva koko ilanga. Nditsho neenkawu azikwazi ukwenza icebo.

xh05-06.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
xh05-06.draft: IJeffreys Bay: apho umoya uzilolonga khona phambi komsebenzi wawo eKapa.

xh05-07.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
xh05-07.draft: Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Iinkomo zamkela oko.

xh05-08.en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
xh05-08.draft: Isekude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amahlanu, kodwa istoep sele sigcwele.

xh05-09.en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
xh05-09.draft: Imozulu entle kangaka yeyokubolekwa. Umoya wasempuma-mzantsi ugcina iirisithi.

xh05-10.en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
xh05-10.draft: Usuku oluhle kangangokuba nditsho nexesha lezithuthi ezininzi beliziva ngathi ngumba wokuzikhethela.
xh05-10.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank

xh05-11.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
xh05-11.draft: Isibane sokhuseleko sikhanyise kwangethuba. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kakuhle.

xh05-12.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
xh05-12.draft: Ilifu phezu kwentaba, ipotjie phantsi kwelapa. Zombini zisafuna enye iyure.

xh05-13.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
xh05-13.draft: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi konke. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.

xh05-14.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
xh05-14.draft: Isiqingatha senyanga, isiqingatha selifu, umgqomo ugcwele. NgoLwesibini ebusuku, njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe.

xh05-15.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
xh05-15.draft: Umsi ufike eyadini yabamelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo ngoku yeyoluntu lonke.

xh05-16.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
xh05-16.draft: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Nxiba iimpahla ezifudumeleyo kumboniso.

xh05-17.en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.

xh05-18.en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.
xh05-18.draft: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza koma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.

xh05-19.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
xh05-19.draft: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwindawo yeziqhamo namhlanje. Ipholisa simahla, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.

xh05-20.en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.

xh05-21.en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.
xh05-21.draft: UGqirha uhamba ejonga kusasa. Akufuneki kubhukisha, ngelishwa.

xh05-22.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
xh05-22.draft: Amafu ahlale kade ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMvulo ebetyala wonke umntu oko.

xh06-01.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
xh06-01.draft: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela ibala zihamba kancinci. Akukho mntu ukhalazayo.

xh06-02.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
xh06-02.draft: Yonke ifestile ekhanyayo ngumntu ogqibe kwelokuba: kwanele namhlanje.

xh06-03.en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
xh06-03.draft: Ungwevu kusasa. Mayihlale nje kancinci, njengeti.

xh06-04.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
xh06-04.draft: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMvulo uqala kancinci.

xh06-05.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
xh06-05.draft: Umoya omncinci uthutha i-jacaranda iye kwesinye isitrato, intyatyambo ngentyatyambo. Istoep siyavuma.

xh06-06.en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
xh06-06.draft: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Yintshayelelo leyo.

xh06-07.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
xh06-07.draft: Amafu alinike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibini. Akukho mntu uxelele ubumanzi bomoya.

xh06-08.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
xh06-08.draft: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Yile ndlela uMvulo ozolileyo ukhangeleka ngayo apha.

xh06-09.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
xh06-09.draft: Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga asiyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Lichiza.

xh06-10.en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
xh06-10.draft: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, inyani, kubanda ngakumbi.

xh06-11.en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.
xh06-11.held: held: a safety line — needs the safety rule record (Claude + Sol) first

xh06-12.en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.
xh06-12.draft: ITar emanzi ekuphumeni kwelanga. Asilovumba elo, lilifa.

xh06-13.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
xh06-13.draft: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nesithunzi. Ihlala khona.

xh06-14.en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.

xh06-15.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.

xh06-16.en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.
xh06-16.draft: Ungwevu nawo ngumbala, utsho umama. Namhlanje ndiyamkholelwa.

xh06-17.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
xh06-17.draft: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.

xh06-18.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
xh06-18.draft: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajiwuzela. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.

xh06-19.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
xh06-19.draft: Amagqabi asoloko ekhanyisa isibane sokhuseleko. Inja ayisaphakami ngenxa yawo.

xh06-20.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
xh06-20.draft: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uzibonakalisa nje kumntwana.

xh06-21.en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.
xh06-21.draft: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungalimbi. Kugqibelele.

xh06-22.en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.
xh06-22.draft: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linuka kamnandi.

xh07-01.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
xh07-01.draft: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, kunye nebhalkoni.

xh07-02.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
xh07-02.draft: Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawangawangisa nje.

xh07-03.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
xh07-03.draft: Umntu uyilibele impahla. Umoya omncinci awuyilibalanga, kwaye wenza umsebenzi omhle.

xh07-04.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
xh07-04.draft: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda.

xh07-05.en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
xh07-05.draft: Uphefumla ngathi yinamba enomlilo, umbono ngathi liphupha.

xh07-06.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
xh07-06.draft: Umoya omncinci uthwala umsi usiwa ezantsi kwesitrato. Isitrato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.

xh07-07.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
xh07-07.draft: Impahla iza koma phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.

xh07-08.en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
xh07-08.draft: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iimpahla ezine nomoya omhle.

xh07-09.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.

xh07-10.en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
xh07-10.draft: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli konke konke.

xh07-11.en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
xh07-11.draft: Ababaleki bango-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.

xh07-12.en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
xh07-12.draft: Imvula yaseJoburg inedayari: ngo-2 emva kwemini kanye, idrama eninzi, akukho kuxolisa.

xh07-13.en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.
xh07-13.draft: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ibhityileyo.

xh07-14.en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.
xh07-14.draft: Kumanqanaba amadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisipho sasimahla.

xh07-15.en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
xh07-15.draft: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.

xh07-16.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
xh07-16.draft: Impahla bekufanele ingene kwiiyure ezidlulileyo. Umoya omncinci uvote ukuba ihlale.

xh07-17.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
xh07-17.draft: Iinkomo zisekhaya phambi kokuba umbala uphele. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.

xh07-18.en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
xh07-18.draft: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka ngokuqinisekileyo iceba into.

xh07-19.en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
xh07-19.draft: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa ngumkhenkce kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.

xh07-20.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
xh07-20.draft: Amagqabi eentyatyambo ze-jacaranda nawo akhwele ibhasi. Umoya omncinci uwathengele amatikiti.

xh07-21.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
xh07-21.draft: Isanti iwela indlela ukhozo ngokhozo. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.

xh07-22.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
xh07-22.draft: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya omncinci ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nootitshala.
